reuse.reason: The official locale plugin owns the runtime, dictionaries, settings row and Host preference, but it has no address strategy: switching the language would not update the URL. This plugin composes the official locale service and adds the prefix synchronization without forking the official runtime. Prefix rules come only from @dsh-base/locale-path: Chinese is /zh-CN, the other six languages use their bare id, English is unprefixed. A canonical prefix at boot selects that language; a bare address keeps the saved preference instead of forcing English.
